entities.name: Chernobyl Fallout & National Revival
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Chernobyl disaster (April 26, 1986) contaminated vast areas of southern Belarus. The Kurapaty mass grave discovery (1988) exposed Stalinist repressions, fuelling the Belarusian Popular Front movement and sovereignty declaration (1990).
